question: Does a finer controller (per-DynSyn-group tones) break the ~1.5 s stance ceiling that made every league game invalid?
context: v0.0.15 gate failed (stance 0/24, reach 0/24) and its rerun reproduced every trial, the training history and the final parameters exactly; root cause in grokbot/redteam/cycle-0019.md
classification: single-athlete motor diagnostic in the shared two-person world; not boxing, not self-play, not an Elo claim
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)
opponent: frozen v0.0.11 gen4 posture policy (deterministic) in corner B

candidate.kind: grokbot.motor_primitives.GroupPolicy (138 group tones + 140 LinearPolicy params, regional feedback applied per group, + 6 punch params = 284)
candidate.init: group_params(gen4, onset=-3.0, duration=0.0, amplitude=2.0): group tones copied from gen4's regional tones (identical commands to the v0.0.15 init on the 656 muscles whose group sits in one region)

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)

criteria.primary_motor_gate: stance_pass_rate >= 0.50 AND reach_pass_rate >= 0.50 over the 24 gate trials
criteria.secondary: paired stand-time gain vs the gen4 baseline on the same 24 seeds, one-sided 95% Hoeffding lower bound (gains clipped to [-3, 3] s); also vs the v0.0.15 candidate
criteria.level_up: v0.0.16 is a level-up (tagged) iff the primary motor gate passes

pre_declared_readings: stance still fails with no stand-time gain: open-loop tone capacity is not the limit; next lever is feedback/recurrent control or jekko's pretrained bridge
stand time improves but stance fails: capacity helps; scale iterations or add per-group feedback
stance passes, reach fails: retarget reach before any league
both pass: preregister a league with the stage-1 valid-game floor and Elo vs the v0.0.12 baseline
